# noise-java

Cantor vendors the upstream Java reference implementation from
`https://github.com/rweather/noise-java` at commit
`49377b6dfc6a1e75740bce2318118291a57c0d6e`.

Only the unmodified `com.southernstorm.noise.crypto` and
`com.southernstorm.noise.protocol` source packages are included. They are used
by Cantor's Android native bridge for `Noise_NK_25519_ChaChaPoly_SHA256`.

License: MIT. See `LICENSE.txt` in this directory.
